name: Metal Dollar
oneLiner: XMD is Metallicus's basket-backed dollar token on XPR Network, reserved by USDC, PYUSD, and Paxos-dollar stablecoins managed by the issuer.
collateral: Reserve basket of dollar stablecoins used by Metal Dollar, including USDC, PYUSD, and Paxos-dollar components such as USDP / XPAX
pegMechanism: Basket-backed stablecoin index on XPR Network, with mint and redeem flows intended to keep XMD near one U.S. dollar against the underlying stablecoin basket

applicabilityBasis.summary: XMD is a U.S.-linked stablecoin index redeemable against a basket of reserve-backed dollar stablecoins rather than a standalone fiat-reserve issuance.

genius.notes: XMD is stablecoin-adjacent and payment-oriented, but its basket-index structure makes GENIUS payment-stablecoin applicability unresolved. Metallicus published educational GENIUS Act content (metaldollar.com, Mar 2026) and operates a credit-union stablecoin sandbox pilot, but no token-specific PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application was found. No GENIUS enforcement action found. Quarterly company reports exist but no monthly reserve attestation.

sources.label: XPR Network public API (get_abi / get_table_rows / get_account)

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: On-chain reads on 2026-07-30 via the public XPR Network Antelope API (head block 395509206): the XMD token contract xmd.token exposes a standard eosio.token ABI (close, create, issue, open, retire, transfer) with only accounts/stat tables, so no freeze, blacklist, or per-account hold path exists on XMD itself. Reach of issuer controls: the xmd.treasury contract (actions settoken/removetoken/setglobals) can pause mint and redemption globally (xmdglobals.isPaused, currently 0) or per basket asset (tokens.isPaused) — a mint/redemption gate, not a transfer freeze. Inherited exposure: (1) basket constituent MPD's contract mpd.token has a pausempd action enabling a global MPD transfer pause (currently is_paused 0); (2) the XUSDC/XPYUSD/XPAX basket assets are xtokens bridge wrappers whose upstream USDC (Circle) and PYUSD/USDP (Paxos) tokens are issuer-blacklistable on their native chains, so the bridge reserves and bridged redemption flows inherit upstream freeze reach; (3) XPR Network is an Antelope chain where block producers can apply protocol-level account blacklists. Controlling authority: owner/active permissions of xmd.token, xmd.treasury, xtokens, and mpd.token all resolve on-chain to swapscold, a 2-of-4 Metallicus operator multisig (metalcfo, swapsledger2, swapsledger3, swapsledger4). Failure domains: xpr-network:swapscold (pause and contract-control domain) plus Circle and Paxos upstream blacklist reach over the underlying basket reserves.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Pharos access research agent (unknown-reduction wave 2, T09)

notices.title: XPR Network contract gap
notices.message: CoinGecko resolves XMD on XPR Network, which is not currently a Pharos-supported chain. Runtime coverage uses CoinGecko price and market cap, while contract-level coverage is intentionally skipped.

mintAuthority.summary: XMD is minted/redeemed 1:1 by users depositing whitelisted reserve stablecoins into the xmd.treasury smart contract on XPR Network (Antelope). On-chain reads on 2026-07-20 via the public XPR Network API resolved the full authority chain: the token contract xmd.token names xmd.treasury as issuer, and both contracts' owner permission resolves to swapscold, a 2-of-4 Antelope account multisig of Metallicus operator accounts. Basket composition is governed on-chain by the xmd.treasury settoken/removetoken/setglobals actions under that same authority; no separate MTL token-holder governor contract appears in the permission chain.

controls.label: swapscold 2-of-4 Metallicus operator permission
controls.evidence: On-chain reads 2026-07-20 via the XPR Network Antelope API (head block ~393650362, chain_id 384da888...): the xmd.treasury contract ABI exposes settoken/removetoken/setglobals, and its tokens table lists the whitelisted basket (MPD 2%, XPAX 15%, XUSDC 60%, XPYUSD 15% maxTreasuryPercent; isPaused = 0 in xmdglobals). Executable authority over these basket parameters resolves through the contract's owner permission to account swapscold, whose owner permission is threshold 2 over four Metallicus operator accounts (metalcfo, swapsledger2, swapsledger3, swapsledger4, weight 1 each) — a 2-of-4 multisig. No MTL token-holder governor contract appears in the xmd.treasury permission chain; Metal DAO voting operates at most as an off-chain signaling layer above this executable authority.

controls.label: XMD treasury mint/redeem contract
controls.evidence: On-chain reads 2026-07-20 via the XPR Network Antelope API: the xmd.token stat table names xmd.treasury as the XMD issuer with supply 2,552,733.883527 XMD and max_supply 0 (no hard cap); xmd.treasury last_code_update 2023-03-25. The contract mints XMD against user deposits of whitelisted basket stablecoins (tokens table: MPD, XPAX, XUSDC, XPYUSD, each mint/redeem-enabled with composition caps) and burns on redemption; active permission is the contract's own eosio.code, owner permission is swapscold (2-of-4 Metallicus multisig). Supply tracks user deposits 1:1 rather than discretionary issuer minting.
controls.capDescription: XMD mint is bounded by user deposits of whitelisted basket stablecoins and the per-asset maxTreasuryPercent composition caps in the xmd.treasury tokens table (MPD 2%, XPAX 15%, XUSDC 60%, XPYUSD 15%); the contract cannot change those caps itself — only its swapscold owner can via settoken.

sources.label: How do I mint Metal Dollar (XMD)?

review.evidence: Metallicus/XPR Network docs and coverage describe XMD as a reserve-backed stablecoin index treasury: users mint/redeem 1:1 against a basket of fiat-backed stablecoins (USDC, PYUSD, XPAX, MPD). The previously blocking gap — no readable XPR Network RPC — is resolved: the public Antelope API (proton.eosusa.io, chain_id 384da888112027f0321850a169f737c33e53b388aad48b5adace4bab97f437e0) was read on 2026-07-20 at head block ~393650362. Findings: (1) xmd.token stat table names issuer xmd.treasury, supply 2,552,733.883527 XMD, max_supply 0; (2) xmd.treasury tokens table lists the whitelist (MPD 2%, XPAX 15%, XUSDC 60%, XPYUSD 15% maxTreasuryPercent, mintFee/redemptionFee 0, isPaused 0) and its ABI exposes only settoken/removetoken/setglobals; (3) both xmd.token and xmd.treasury resolve their owner permission to swapscold, threshold 2 over metalcfo, swapsledger2, swapsledger3, swapsledger4 — a 2-of-4 Metallicus operator multisig; (4) no MTL token-holder governor contract exists in the executable permission chain. All mint-critical authorities are now enumerated on-chain; no unilateral Metallicus mint path beyond the 2-of-4 multisig was found.
